data.body: RELEASED by the client 2026-11-06 ('2 PQ-58 PQ-61 pq-80'); held tag dropped. Dispatching a fast-track delegator (Opus, Codex review) with one planned halt: QUESTION PQ-61 (credential path) after the plan; the guard test proceeds meanwhile. CI config is serialized to this ticket this wave. Boot: .lattice/orchestration/templates/boot-PQ-61.md. Worktree ~/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/pq-61-deployed-burst-secrets on ai-c11-cc/pq-61-deployed-burst-secrets from origin/main c810d0d. Lands first of the three.
READY PQ-61 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/pq-61-deployed-burst-secrets HEAD c810d0dc44955d69f3679b35f67523ec91c8423e BASE c810d0dc44955d69f3679b35f67523ec91c8423e MODE active

PLAN PQ-61 /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/.lattice/plans/task_01M461K1VEHR6CTSJJQ71PHWPT.md Workflow is already environment-scoped and dispatch-only; guard goes in popquiz/tests/harness_config.rs with four conditions and six plants; README and RUNBOOK agree; only the workflow header's line 6 still says 'repository secret'.

QUESTION PQ-61 (credential path): workflow re-verified at c810d0d: environment secrets (deployed-burst environment, job line 75; reads at 86, 87, 133, 157, 172, all env: mappings), triggers workflow_dispatch only. Options A (SPEC §8 names the deployed-burst path; wording: §8.3 gains "(its one other holder is the deployed burst's environment, §8.4)" after "never in the repository", plus a new "### 8.4 The deployed burst (T-21, AC-53)": "AC-53's run against the deployed substrate, `.github/workflows/deployed-burst.yml`, carries two credentials: the organizer session of a signed-in `/host` page (`POPQUIZ_ORGANIZER_SESSION`, one person's, 12 hours) and the admin token (`POPQUIZ_ADMIN_TOKEN`, §8.3). Both are secrets of the `deployed-burst` GitHub **environment**, never repository secrets: the client sets them right before a run and deletes them right after. The environment's required reviewer and its main-only branch rule keep a workflow edited on a branch from reading them. The workflow runs only on `workflow_dispatch`; only the job that declares that environment reads them, and only into an `env:` mapping; neither is echoed, put on a command line or written to a file. The functions that already check them still do: the burst adds a holder, not a path. A `test` keeps the workflow to this paragraph.") / B (one-run inputs; worse: dispatch inputs are not masked, so both values sit in plaintext in the run's event payload, the Actions UI and the API for anyone with read access for the retention period, and the required-reviewer gate is lost) / C (contract note only). EVALUATION row: none needed; optional append to AC-53: "The run's two credentials are held as `SPEC.md` §8.4 says; `test`: `harness_config.rs` keeps the workflow to it." Also: may I fix deployed-burst.yml:6, "set as a repository secret", to "set as a secret of the `deployed-burst` environment"? It contradicts the header's own line 28 and the README. Recommended: A, plus the line-6 fix. Reply RESUME PQ-61 A|B|C [with any wording edits].

WAITING PQ-61: guard committed at b56d4d9 (popquiz/tests/harness_config.rs, four tests, six reverted plants each RED on its own test); just test green; README and RUNBOOK agree, no change. Halted on QUESTION PQ-61 (credential path): reply RESUME PQ-61 A|B|C, and say whether deployed-burst.yml:6 ('repository secret') may be fixed. Checkpoint: .claude/checkpoint-pq61.md in the worktree.

RULING PQ-61 from the client in panel 22 (2026-11-06): 'RESUNE PQ-61 A and yes' = option A with the drafted wording unchanged, and yes to fixing deployed-burst.yml:6. The optional EVALUATION AC-53 line was not in the recommendation and is not applied.

BLOCKED PQ-61: the signed commit of the hardened guard (staged in popquiz/tests/harness_config.rs, just test green, 22 plants RED) failed twice with '1Password: failed to fill whole buffer' / 'fatal: failed to write commit object', the second time after the client unlocked and said go. Needs the client to check 1Password's SSH agent (an approval prompt may have timed out). HEAD 688e935; resume: commit the staged file, then Codex re-review (pass 2 of 2).

BLOCKED PQ-61 (review cap): Codex pass 2 FAIL at 950c4e9, four Majors open (see the review note). Run guardrail: two passes used; the client decides: (a) authorize one more fix pass (pin every step of the deployed-burst job and the env keys of holding steps; allowlist secret expressions and refuse multiline/block-scalar values in every workflow), or (b) open the PR as is with the four listed as known limits in Contract notes. Not pushed.

RULING PQ-61 from the client in panel 22: '9a0', read as '(a)': one more fix pass beyond the two-review cap, then a third Codex review. Continuing in a fresh session from .claude/checkpoint-pq61.md in the worktree.

BLOCKED PQ-61 (review pass 3 not run): fix pass committed at 7001097 (whole-file pin of deployed-burst.yml, SECRET_READS allowlist, one-line expressions, no backslash or block scalar but run/path outside scripts); thirty reverted plants all RED; just test green 28 s. Codex pass 3 returned no verdict: the service refused mid-review with 'This content was flagged for possible cybersecurity risk' (log /var/folders/gb/0dxb2vbx6ls104m2g7c82s_00000gn/T/pq61-codex-log3.txt:7880). Client decides: (a) rerun Codex once with the boot's neutral review wording (no request for exploit text), or (b) open the PR with pass 3 recorded as not run. Not pushed.
RULING PQ-61 from the client in panel 22: 'a' = rerun Codex pass 3 once with the boot's neutral review wording; if refused again, open the PR with pass 3 recorded as not run.

BLOCKED PQ-61 (review pass 3 FAIL at 7001097): the pinned deployed-burst.yml has no leak found, but the cross-workflow scan misses two YAML shapes in another workflow: a comment ending ': |' that switches off the escape check (then \u escapes spell the secret and the environment), and a flow-style job naming the environment. Client decides: (a) one more pass that refuses flow collections and comment-opened blocks, (b) a YAML parser as a dev-dependency (cargo add, needs approval), or (c) PR as is with these as contract notes. Not pushed.
